keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «다이얼이 꽉 끼어서 움직이지 않았다(문제)» 와 «발명품은 보여 주기 전에 꼼꼼히 시험해야 한다(교훈)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the problem (the dial got stuck) and the lesson (test inventions carefully before showing them). The green sentences are the answers.

qs.q: Why did the gym fill up with snow?
opts: The dial got stuck, and the snow kept getting heavier.
A real snowstorm came into the gym from outside.
evs: So she built a weather machine out of an old fan, a fridge part, and a lot of wires.
But then the dial got stuck.
Warm light filled the room, and the snow melted.
Little snowflakes fell on the judges, and everyone clapped.
why: 다이얼이 꽉 끼어 움직이지 않아서 눈이 점점 더 많이 내렸어요. 지수가 다이얼을 «Sun» 으로 돌린 것은 눈을 멈추려고 나중에 한 일이에요.
The dial got stuck, so the snow kept getting heavier. Jisu turned the dial to "Sun" later, to stop the snow.

qs.q: The text says, "One red wire was loose." What does loose mean here?
qs.qko: "One red wire was loose."라고 나와요. 여기서 loose는 무슨 뜻인가요?
evs: She fixed it with shaking hands and turned the dial to "Sun."
Students screamed and slid across the floor.
Jisu loved science, and she wanted to win the school science fair.
On the day of the fair, she turned the dial to "Snow."
why: 지수가 그 전선을 고치자 기계가 다시 제대로 움직였어요. 그러니 loose는 «꽉 연결되어 있지 않은» 이라는 뜻이에요.
After Jisu fixed the wire, the machine worked again. So loose means the wire was not connected tightly.

qs.q: Why did Jisu learn to test her inventions before showing them?
qs.qko: 지수는 왜 발명품을 보여 주기 전에 시험해 봐야 한다는 것을 배웠나요?
opts: Her machine went wrong in front of everyone at the fair.
The judges told her to stop inventing.
She won first prize too easily.
evs: But then the dial got stuck.
Jisu loved science, and she wanted to win the school science fair.
Soon the gym was full of snow, and the wind was howling!
Warm light filled the room, and the snow melted.
why: 대회 날 모두가 보는 앞에서 다이얼이 꽉 끼었고, 체육관이 눈으로 가득 찼어요. 이 두 문장을 이으면 왜 미리 시험해야 하는지 알 수 있어요.
On the day of the fair, the dial got stuck, and the gym filled with snow in front of everyone. These two clues show why she must test first.

ends: Jisu builds a better machine and tests it many times.
지수가 더 좋은 기계를 만들고 여러 번 시험해요.
The school asks Jisu to make snow for a winter festival.
학교가 겨울 축제를 위해 지수에게 눈을 만들어 달라고 부탁해요.

write.src: “Let’s <u>test the machine</u> before <u>we show it to everyone</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «함께 할 일 + 그보다 나중에 일어날 일» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write what to do together and what happens later in English.

chips.b: we give the test to the teacher

write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «before» 뒤에 «누가 + 무엇을» 넣어 써 보세요. (예: before the bell rings)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «before», write who + what. (e.g. before the bell rings)

img.cover: Inside a school gym full of swirling snow, a girl with a curly brown ponytail and big safety goggles on her head in a green lab coat crawls toward a big boxy machine made of an old fan, a fridge part, and colorful wires, while laughing students slide across the snowy floor and three judges at a long table are covered in snow like snowmen.

scenes.2: In the snowy school gym, a girl with a curly brown ponytail and big safety goggles on her head in a green lab coat kneels in deep snow behind a big boxy machine made of an old fan, a fridge part, and colorful wires, opens a small back door, and points at one loose red wire among the colorful wires, while snowflakes swirl around her.
scenes.3: In the school gym, warm golden light shines from a big boxy machine made of an old fan, a fridge part, and colorful wires, the snow melts into shiny puddles, smiling students shake snow off their clothes, and a girl with a curly brown ponytail and big safety goggles on her head in a green lab coat sits beside the machine with a big relieved smile.

alt.2: Jisu finds a loose red wire in the machine.
alt.3: Warm light melts the snow in the gym.
